test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain sum amounts to ₹98,494 at the rate of 15% per annum in 2 years, interest compounded 8-monthly. What will be the amount payable (in ₹) on the same sum at the same rate and in the same time, if the interest is compounded yearly?
solution:
Given:

Amount on a sum for 2 years @ 15% p.a compounded 8-monthly = Rs.98,494

Concept used 

A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

Calculation :

rate is compounded 8-monthly

⇒ n = 24/8 (∵ Time is 2 years i.e. 24 months)

⇒ n = 3

The rate is 15 % p.a 

⇒ For 8-monthly rate = (15/12) × 8

⇒ rate = 10% per 8-month

Let the principal be P

using given values of rate, n, and amount

⇒ 98494 = P × 11/10 × 11/10 × 11/10

P = 74000

A = 74000 × 23/20 × 23/20

= 97865

∴ The required amount is Rs 97865
